personality: 2 Material You / Expressive LIGHT or DARK
personality_one_liner: A fresh, botanical-inspired emerald identity that feels organic, encouraging, and vibrant for language learners.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Let the fresh green accents breathe. Use md/lg margins around cards.

do's: Use glass on the bottom tab bar
Use glass on sticky headers over the Moments feed
dont's: Don't use glass on chat bubbles or standard content cards

screens.name: Moments
screens.purpose: Social feed where language learners share tinted content cards.

states.empty: Botanical illustration with 'No moments yet. Share your first learning experience!'
states.error: Readable error message with a retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll feed. Cards use subtle pastel tints (cardTints). Tab bar is glass over the scrolling content.

screens.name: Chat
screens.purpose: 1:1 communication using organic, color-tinted chat bubbles and voice waveforms.
screens.layout: Standard chat layout. Input at the bottom with KeyboardAvoidingView. Messages scroll up. Mine on right, theirs on left.
